content: Hi how can i assist you today
Other cars’ turn signals start blinking as I think of a question. It feels like a reply.
Signals blink at fixed rates and start whenever a driver initiates a turn or lane change. Heavy traffic creates many overlapping cycles.
It’s most noticeable at a busy junction.
That environment increases simultaneous blinks, which can align with any passing thought.
When the road is empty, I don’t get the same feeling.
Fewer overlapping cycles reduce coincidental matches.
So density is driving the impression.
Traffic density often explains that experience.
